target.title: fix(google-meet): actually leave the Meet call in the browser on leave (#103386)
target.body:
## Summary

Fixes #103386.

`openclaw googlemeet leave <session-id>` on the Chrome transports printed `left <session-id>` and marked the session `ended`, but only ran the registered stop hook (the realtime audio bridge; in transcribe mode nothing at all). No code path touched the meeting, so the browser participant kept sitting in the call — a ghost participant receiving audio/captions after the operator was told it left. Twilio sessions already end the real call via their stop hook, so the transports were inconsistent.

### Change

- `extensions/google-meet/src/transports/chrome.ts`: new `leaveChromeMeet` / `leaveChromeMeetOnNode` (shared `leaveMeetWithBrowserRequest` core). It finds the session's Meet tab, clicks Meet's **Leave call** button via browser evaluate (reliable now that tabs are pinned to `?hl=en`), then closes the tab so departure is guaranteed even when the click misses. Failures degrade to session notes instead of throwing — `leave` still ends the session.
- `extensions/google-meet/src/runtime.ts`: `leave()` calls the browser leave for `chrome`/`chrome-node` sessions and records the outcome in session notes. Two guards:
  - the internal tab-reassignment path in `join()` passes `keepBrowserTab: true` so agent handoff keeps the in-call tab and avoids lobby re-admission;
  - a shared-tab guard skips closing while another active session still uses the same Meet tab.
- `docs/plugins/google-meet.md`: `leave` row now documents the Chrome-transport behavior.

## Verification

- `pnpm test extensions/google-meet` — 17 files, 208 tests passed (includes 3 new tests: browser leave click+close, no-matching-tab leave still ends the session with a note, and a vm test that the leave script clicks only an enabled Leave call button).
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions && pnpm tsgo:extensions:test` — clean.
- `pnpm format` / oxlint on touched files — clean.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: `googlemeet leave` leaves the browser participant in the Google Meet call on chrome/chrome-node transports while reporting `left`.
Real environment tested: No live Google Meet call was run; behavior is proven at the browser-proxy request boundary with the plugin's existing stubbed-gateway test harness (same harness the join/status paths use).
Exact steps or command run after this patch: `pnpm test extensions/google-meet` and `pnpm test extensions/google-meet/index.test.ts`.
Evidence after fix: New test "leaves the Meet call in the browser when a chrome session leaves" asserts the `/act` evaluate carries the leave-click script against the session tab and that `DELETE /tabs/local-meet-tab` is issued; session notes record "Clicked Meet's Leave call button and closed the Meet tab."
Observed result after fix: 208/208 tests pass; leave now issues real browser actions and the session ends with an explanatory note when no tab matches.
What was not tested: A live Meet meeting (real Chrome, real Google account) and the chrome-node transport against a physical node; both share `leaveMeetWithBrowserRequest`, which is covered by the harness.
